title: Rtractor: Complexity and Nonlinear Time Series Analysis for Physiological Signals
description: A staging- and signal-agnostic toolkit of complex systems measures for physiological time series: entropy (sample, permutation, approximate), fractal and multifractal analysis (Higuchi dimension, DFA, MFDFA), Lyapunov exponents, multiscale entropy, and recurrence quantification analysis. Core algorithms wrap established C/C++/Fortran reference implementations rather than reimplementing them in pure R, to preserve numerical parity with the original methods literature. Designed to sit underneath other Circadia Lab and CoDe-Neuro Lab packages (mrpheus, hypnoR, zeitR, dynR) as a shared complexity-metrics layer, while remaining fully usable standalone on any numeric time series.
